key.text: I want to make a phone stand for my desk out of wood. It should hold my phone at a slight angle, fit in my hand, and I only need one.

output.summary: A wooden phone stand for a desk

needs.why: To cut and shape wood for the stand

ways_considered.reason: Requires advanced training not suited for a beginner

ways_considered.process: Cut and shape wood using the shared woodshop
ways_considered.reason: Great for beginners to use basic tools

routes.process: Cut and shape a small wooden stand
routes.fit_reason: This space provides all the tools needed to shape wood easily. It is friendly for beginners.

steps.title: Design the piece
steps.detail: Sketch your phone stand on paper and check the dimensions.

steps.title: Ask at the tool crib
steps.detail: Ask staff at the tool crib for help and to check out tools.

steps.title: Assemble and finish
steps.detail: Glue or fit your wooden pieces together to finish your stand.
